tools.name: page_history
tools.description: CHANGE EVIDENCE: With a trial or paid key, retrieve recorded timestamps and fingerprints for a fixed-monitored page or your own watched GOV.UK page. History starts when monitoring starts; do not invent older revisions.

tools.description: CHANGE EVIDENCE: With a trial or paid key, compare the last two distinct snapshots UKSI actually recorded for an eligible GOV.UK page. Get added/removed text blocks to support a sourced change explanation. If there is only a baseline or no difference, clearly say no demonstrated change.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_source_evidence, my_watch_changes, watch_govuk_page · Private data: get_govuk_change_brief, fixed_monitored_pages, watch_govuk_page · Public sink: start_free_trial, my_watch_changes, watch_govuk_page · Destructive: preview_source_evidence, remove_govuk_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_source_evidence, my_watch_changes, watch_govuk_page · Private data: get_govuk_change_brief, fixed_monitored_pages, watch_govuk_page · Public sink: start_free_trial, my_watch_changes, watch_govuk_page · Destructive: preview_source_evidence, remove_govuk_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
